description.en: Creates a named telop caption showing an avatar/pet's name above it (a variant of CMND_2DO_CREATE_TELOP taking both a telop name and the avatar name-tag text to render).
Internal name to register the telop under.
Font size for the avatar name.
True once it succeeded; false if the effect being created isn't ready/found; null if the call itself was invalid (too few arguments).

example.code:
// Create a telop showing a pet avatar's name
CMND_2DO_CREATE_AVA_TELOP("\x008bZ\x0090\x00ea\x0097p\x0096\x00bc", "\x0088\x00a4\x008f\x00cc\x0090\x00ea\x0097p\x0096\x00bc", 0, 12, 0, fn, wh, iAvaPetNameSize, 6);
